title: Round 2: focused, professional, heavy
question: Four new families from the audit and investigation side of aviation. All dark-or-bold, no playful costume. Hero images are stand-ins.

options.label: Fuselage Stencil
options.lineage: aircraft fuselage and hangar panel stencilling
options.thesis: Stencilled titles on a steel panel, one safety-yellow word, rivets and panel IDs as the only decoration.
options.viewport: Two-line monumental stencil title across the panel, a wide hero strip below, mono panel IDs in the margins.
options.risk: Heavy stencil caps tire the eye on text-dense slides, so body slides must drop to a plain grotesk.

raised.raise: A strict cell grid: every slide snaps to the same 12-column panel, no free-floating blocks.

options.label: Evidence Bundle
options.thesis: The deck is an exhibit binder: numbered tabs, heavy black type, claims set against the evidence on the same sheet.
options.viewport: One sheet on a grey desk, condensed black title, side tabs 1-3, a tall hero strip at right.
options.risk: Light and familiar from audit reports, but a red stamp used on every slide would turn gimmicky.

options.label: Investigation Report
options.thesis: Sober black pages, a heavy serif that argues in full sentences, one orange band as the only colour.
options.viewport: Orange spine, rule, heavy serif title, one plain sentence, full-height hero at the right edge.
options.risk: Dark ground is hard on a bright projector; needs light data slides.

options.label: Board Report
options.thesis: Navy, ivory and one gold, with very large type and nothing else; credibility through restraint.
options.viewport: Huge title top, ruled line, a single question in gold, hero block lower right.
options.risk: Safe and corporate; the weight must come from scale, not decoration.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.case: Fuses poorly: bitmap blocks read retro and playful, not heavy and professional.
options.kept: The rigid cell grid every element snaps to.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white academic deck, navy headings, figure left, bullets right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other group by design.
